title: Reviewed Credit Limit — FlexLine Credit Review Calculation
content:
For FlexLine Personal Lines of Credit, the limit set by a credit review of a past-due line is calculated as follows.

**Clause.** The reviewed limit is the credit limit less the review cut of 10% of it, rounded down to the next 100.00 USD, never below the outstanding balance rounded up to the next 100.00 USD and never below the tier's minimum credit limit, and never above the credit limit before the review.

**Order.** The cut is taken off the credit limit; the result is rounded down to the next 100.00 USD; and it is then raised to the outstanding balance rounded up to the next 100.00 USD, or to the tier's minimum credit limit, if it is below either, but never above the credit limit before the review. Every rounding to the cent here takes an exact half cent to the even cent.

**Inputs.** The credit limit and the outstanding balance are those on Larkspur's record of the line on the review date; the tier's minimum credit limit is the lowest credit limit of the line's tier.

## Worked examples (hypothetical inputs, FlexLine Standard, lowest limit 2500 USD)

| Credit limit | Outstanding balance | Limit less 10% | Rounded down to 100 | Balance rounded up to 100 | Reviewed limit |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 4700.00 | 2950.00 | 4230.00 | 4200.00 | 3000.00 | 4200.00 |
| 3200.00 | 3010.00 | 2880.00 | 2800.00 | 3100.00 | 3100.00 |
| 2600.00 | 500.00 | 2340.00 | 2300.00 | 500.00 | 2500.00 (tier minimum) |
| 5150.00 | 1720.00 | 4635.00 | 4600.00 | 1800.00 | 4600.00 |
| 2600.00 | 2750.00 | 2340.00 | 2300.00 | 2800.00 | 2600.00 (the limit before the review) |

A figure already on a multiple of 100.00 stays where it is when rounded down or up.
